node_definition.done_when: tests/test_a_blocking_figure_finding_refuses_promotion.py passes: a run carrying a stored text review with no blocking finding and a stored figure review with one undisposed blocking finding is refused by crew complete with a reason naming the figure; the same run with that finding disposed through crew dispose is promoted; a run whose text review carries a blocking finding and which has no figure review is promoted as it is today. Read a finding's severity through the existing owner (blocking_findings in reckon/crew/repair.py) rather than adding a third severity reader, and the figure review through read_review with the figure rubric. The test builds its stores in a temporary directory and reads nothing outside it. ruff check and ruff format --check add no findings on changed Python files. Every log is written under the run directory, starts with its revision and the literal command, and ends in EXIT=. The coordinator runs the importer population of reckon/crew/promotion_checks.py at merge; do not run a base arm
